overview: This database appears to power a comprehensive educational and career-development platform. It manages user accounts, courses, cohorts, and student applications alongside attendance tracking, assignments, exams, and grading. Additionally, it supports mentoring programs, company job postings, placements, and community communications.
areas: Users and authentication: accounts_user, accounts_administratorprofile, accounts_emailverificationotp, accounts_passwordresetotp
Courses and cohorts: courses_course, courses_coursemodule, cohorts_cohort, cohorts_cohortmoduleprogress
Applications and admissions: applications_application, applications_prescreening, applications_prescreeninginterview, exams_exam
Assignments and submissions: assignments_assignment, assignments_submission, assignments_capstoneteam, assignments_capstonereview
Attendance tracking: attendance_attendance, attendance_attendancesummary, attendance_absencewarning, attendance_priorpermission
Exams and grading: exams_internalexamattempt, exams_moduletestsubmission, exams_manualexaminationresult, question
Mentorship and volunteering: mentors_mentorprofile, volunteers_volunteerprofile, volunteers_volunteertask, volunteers_volunteerhelprequest
Placements and companies: companies_company, companies_jobposting, companies_jobposting_applicants, students_studentplacement
notes: The user's full name is stored across the first_name and last_name columns in the accounts_user table.
The user_id column in accounts_administratorprofile, accounts_user_groups, accounts_user_user_permissions, and alumni_alumniprofile references the id column in accounts_user.
The application_id column in applications_applicationstatusaudit and applications_communityactivity references the id column in applications_application.
Columns ending with _id typically reference primary keys of other tables or entities.
Tables starting with assignments_ manage course work, while attendance_ tables track class presence.
Junction tables like attendance_attendance_attendees and attendance_attendance_joined_students link attendance sessions with student profiles.
attendance_priorpermission references students, sessions, and grantors via UUID foreign keys.
Tables prefixed with cohorts_ generally relate to cohort management, messaging, mentoring, and module tracking.
The assessment_id column in cohorts_studentmonthlyassessmentscore likely points to the monthly assessments table.
The cohort_id column appears across multiple tables to associate records with specific cohorts.
